# Kenney Assets

The files listed here were downloaded from Kenney's official asset pages. Kenney did not participate in or endorse this project.

## Game Icons

- Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/game-icons
- Official archive: `kenney_game-icons.zip`
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal
- Imported files:
  - `icons/audio/icon_audio_play.png` (from `right.png`)
  - `icons/audio/icon_audio_pause.png` (from `pause.png`)
  - `icons/audio/icon_audio_marker.png` (from `target.png`)
  - `icons/audio/icon_audio_clue.png` (from `audioOn.png`)
  - `icons/navigation/icon_backtrack.png` (from `return.png`)
  - `icons/navigation/icon_graph.png` (from `share2.png`)
  - `icons/graph/icon_connection_valid.png` (from `checkmark.png`)
  - `icons/graph/icon_connection_invalid.png` (from `cross.png`)
  - `icons/graph/icon_warning.png` (from `warning.png`)
  - `icons/graph/icon_unlock.png` (from `unlocked.png`)
- Modifications: selected the white 2x variants, renamed, scaled and recolored at runtime.
- Original license: `LICENSE_GAME_ICONS.txt`

## Input Prompts

- Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/input-prompts
- Official archive: `kenney_input-prompts_1.5.zip`
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal
- Imported files:
  - `input_prompts/mouse/prompt_mouse_left.svg` (from `mouse_left.svg`)
  - `input_prompts/mouse/prompt_mouse_right.svg` (from `mouse_right.svg`)
  - `input_prompts/mouse/prompt_mouse_drag.svg` (from `mouse_move.svg`)
  - `input_prompts/mouse/prompt_mouse_wheel.svg` (from `mouse_scroll.svg`)
- Modifications: renamed; converted to single-color runtime tinting and reduced inactive mouse-region opacity so left, right, drag, and wheel actions remain visually distinct.
- Original license: `LICENSE_INPUT_PROMPTS.txt`

## Cursor Pack

- Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/cursor-pack
- Official archive: `kenney_cursor-pack.zip`
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal
- Imported files:
  - `cursors/cursor_default.png` (from `PNG/Outline/Default/pointer_a.png`)
  - `cursors/cursor_pointer.png` (from `PNG/Outline/Default/hand_thin_small_point.png`)
  - `cursors/cursor_drag_horizontal.png` (from `PNG/Outline/Default/resize_a_horizontal.png`)
  - `cursors/cursor_connect.png` (from `PNG/Outline/Default/target_a.png`)
  - `cursors/cursor_forbidden.png` (from `PNG/Outline/Default/cursor_disabled.png`)
- Modifications: renamed only; original 32 x 32 PNG images retained.
- Runtime hotspots: default `(1, 1)`, pointer `(7, 2)`, horizontal drag `(16, 16)`, connect `(16, 16)`, forbidden `(2, 2)`.
- Original license: `LICENSE_CURSOR_PACK.txt`
